topic: Report deployment and data import status
summary_markdown:
The primary issue discussed was the failure of reports to return data, suspected to be due to outdated DE keys. The necessary lambda function for reporting was updated and deployed using a CLI command (`serverless deploy function -f report-v3`). A test API call was executed successfully.

Regarding future data needs, it was noted that WallDecaux reports have been empty for a week without detection. For German data, the calculation of sessions is pending until another model runs and subsequent reaggregation occurs. The process for requesting data reimport (specifically for 11/10) requires coordination with the relevant team via Slack, as this has been requested previously.
decisions: The reporting lambda function was successfully updated and deployed.
action_items: Wait for another model to run before reaggregating German session data.
Coordinate with the relevant team via Slack regarding the need to reimport specific historical data (11/10).
